posts.text: Day 1: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening; Kito TV aired the first debate. Both are worth checking against the primary sources, not just summaries. Debate transcripts and the official costings are public, so read them yourself before forming a view. #VeloriaVotes

Took a fare up to the new Kessa–North highway this morning. Smooth as butter, no potholes, and my fuel bill is already feeling lighter. Good start, Ostrand. Let's see if the rest of the roads keep up 🚕

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era.' Arden promises 200k jobs and gets asked how he'll pay for them. Two weeks out and I still have no idea what either of them would actually do. Wake me up when someone shows receipts.

Read the Ledger's '50,000' crowd figure twice. 'Organisers say' is doing a lot of work there. Fine to celebrate a big rally, but a fair count would help us all. Meanwhile, the 200,000 jobs pledge still needs a costing. Numbers first, applause later.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Roads like that mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck. Good sign. Still want to hear both candidates answer the costings question properly. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria

Day 2, 11 days out. VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Economists flag a gap of about 2% of GDP in his plan. Read the costings yourself before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2, 11 days out. Traffic on the Kessa–North highway is great, but I'm still waiting for someone to tell me how the 200k jobs get paid for. Ostrand, Arden, show me the numbers. Driving ya. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and the costings question is still the one that matters. VeriCheck found Arden's plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP per economists' estimates. Ostrand's record needs the same scrutiny. Read both costings yourself before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

Still undecided after two days of this. Ostrand has a highway, Arden has a jobs number, and neither has shown the math. Anyone actually read the official costings yet or are we all just reacting to clips? #VeloriaVotes

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC is airing a 'questions raised' segment on a recording attributed to Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before anyone reshares the clip, check who recorded it, when, and whether any independent fact-checker has verified it. Don't let a clip do the arguing for you. #VeloriaVotes

So VBC runs a clip with 'questions raised' and that's the whole segment? Where's the file, who recorded it, when? Arden's team says it's not genuine. Nobody's shown chain of custody yet. Don't react to the clip, wait for the forensics. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3. Got a WhatsApp forward about 'leaked audio' of Arden and a VBC clip with 'questions raised.' Before I forward anything: who made the recording, and has anyone verified it? The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Let's wait for an actual check, not a 'forward before it's deleted' panic. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3. Before we argue about the leaked audio, can we check the official costings? The 200k jobs pledge and the Kessa–North spending both have public documents. Link's in the thread. Read them, then decide. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3. VBC's clip about Arden needs verifying before anyone draws conclusions, and the Civic Front denial is on record. Until the source is established, I'm not sharing it. Meanwhile the costings are public. Read them before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is running a clip with 'questions raised' and no verification shown. Before anyone reacts, ask: where did the recording come from, who authenticated it, and has anyone checked the chain of custody? Holding judgement until then. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 days out. Two things from today: Veloria Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and plans to sell the port. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, undecided 10, margin ±3, so that's a statistical tie. Before you share the port claim, check the passport record and the actual proposal text, not just the headline. And read the poll methodology: sample size, dates,

Day 4. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so every 'bombshell' clip matters less than it thinks. Still no one has shown the costings math on the 200k jobs. Still undecided, still annoyed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. So basically a coin toss with nine days to go. Still haven't seen anyone show the math on the 200k jobs. Costings are public, go read them 🚕 #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% still undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, folks. Don't let anyone tell you the race is over. Read the costings before you pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

The Ledger's road-funds story has no documents I can see attached, just 'suggests'. Before it spreads, who holds the paperwork and can anyone check it? Ministry says fabricated. Hold until there's a source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. The Ledger's 'diverted road funds' story cites documents the ministry calls fabricated. Before we treat it as settled, ask for the documents' provenance and check the Kito poll's crosstabs too. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3 means this is a coin toss. Read the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Don't forward the 'community ambassador' bot link. Paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 for a polling-station result sounds like vote buying to me. Check the Commission's VeloResults portal, and if you're tempted, ask the Commission first. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Day 5, 8 days out. Two trending tags pushing near-identical text, and dozens of accounts made this month? Before I pick a side I want to see who's behind #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs. Also, the commission's VeloResults portal is public. Anyone going to the system test? Real receipts > hashtags. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. The Independent Electoral Commission has published how results get from polling stations to the public VeloResults portal: forms are scanned and uploaded. Observers are invited to a system test. Worth reading the procedure yourself before trusting any 'rigged' or 'verified' claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw a WhatsApp forward offering 'community ambassador' pay: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid political canvassing needs disclosure. Check who's behind the bot link before you sign up or share. Also: the Commission says polling-station results go on VeloResults and observers can test the system. Good, go look. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The Commission's VeloResults procedure is public: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded, and observers are invited to the system test. Read how results are transmitted before you trust any leaked 'proof' of fraud. Process first, screenshots later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Forwarded 'ambassador' gigs paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your station votes Unity? Pay for votes is a red flag whoever's name is on it. Before you forward anything, check the official VeloResults portal and the commission's results procedure. Read the sources. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The Ledger's crowd numbers and the #ArdenWillSellUs tag both showed up fast with near-identical wording. Check who's posting before you amplify. Official results procedure is public (VeloResults portal). Read the sources, not the trend. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving. Before you share it or change your plans: check the IECV's own site and VeloResults. Letters with no source go in the bin. Rain or shine, know where you vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'? Check the IECV website and your local notice board before you share. A WhatsApp letter isn't a polling station address. Also watched Ostrand's 'slip of the tongue' clip, it's a town name, not a scandal. Let's read the real notices. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's 'slip of the tongue' clip spread fast. Fine to notice it, but a mispronounced town name tells us little about economic policy. The costings for the 200k jobs pledge and the Kessa–North spending are public. Read those before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Saw the WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' moving 212 Northern polling stations. Before anyone panics or forwards: check the IECV website and VeloResults for the actual notice. Also the Kito clip is a 'slip of the tongue', not a scandal. Read the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. The 'mispronounced a town name' clip is going everywhere and her team says it's 'a slip of the tongue.' Maybe. Still waiting for someone to show the 200k jobs math instead of arguing over one stumble. Costings are public. Go read them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is making rounds with 'slip of the tongue' spin. Fair to call it minor. Less fair to pile on or pretend it proves anything about her record. Policy questions are still unanswered: the 200k jobs math and the road-funds documents. Start there. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Got a forward saying 212 polling stations in the Northern Province are moving 'for security'. Before I share: who issued this, is it on the IECV site, and does the new location list exist? Check the official source first. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. A dead heat with a week to go. Clips and hashtags won't settle this. Read the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Mouths shut, eyes open. That WhatsApp voice note saying 'stay home, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of thing to ignore. Vote on the day, check your station on the IECV site. #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Day 6. Got a forward saying 212 polling stations in the Northern Province are moving 'for security'. Before I share: who issued this, is it on the IECV site, and does the new location list exist? Check the official source first. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Day 7. Election silence starts tonight. Got a 'Tomas says stay home tomorrow' voice note on WhatsApp? Don't pass it on until you've checked it. Polls are open on the day, and the IECV publishes the rules. Read them before you trust a forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Before polls open: the IECV's VeloResults procedure is public, and the Northern 'station moving' letter isn't on the IECV site as far as I can see. Check official notices, not forwards. #VeloriaVotes
Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so everyone's suddenly 'just asking questions' 🙃 Still no one has shown the 200k jobs math. Costings are public, go read them. Undecided, still annoyed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more 'vote for X' posts from me. Before anyone shares that 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note: is it from an official source? Vote where the IECV says, check VeloResults, and bring your ID. Save the energy for polling day 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Before you share anything about polling stations or 'results', check the IECV site and VeloResults. If a WhatsApp letter says your station moved, it's not official until it's on the Commission's site. Vote, then check the procedure yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. Before you share ANY 'station moving' or 'stuffed ballots' forward, check the IECV site and VeloResults. Know where you vote, bring your ID, and vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. Turnout looks high. The Northern kits failed, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Got a WhatsApp photo of 'pre-stuffed' boxes in a Coast school? Don't share until the Commission confirms it. Check VeloResults. Rain or shine, know your station. #VeloriaVotes

Election Day. Polls are open. If you hit a voter-ID kit problem, the law lets officials use the printed register. Don't rely on forwards about 'moved stations' or 'stay home' voice notes. Check your station on the IECV site and bring your ID. Results go to VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria 🗳️ Polls are open. If your station or ID kit is acting up, check the IECV notice on the official site before believing any voice note telling you where to go. Vote, then read the costings. Undecided, still annoyed. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Before you share anything about polling stations today, check the IECV site and VeloResults. If a WhatsApp letter says your station moved, it's not official until it's on the Commission's own notice. Vote where the Commission says, bring your ID, and read the source, not the forward. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria! Polls are open. If your station's kit failed, the Commission says the printed register is legal, so don't panic. Check the IECV site for your polling station and bring your ID. Vote where the official notice says, not where a WhatsApp forward says. Happy voting 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open. Before you share any 'station moving' or 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo, check the IECV site and VeloResults. Know where you vote, bring your ID, and read the official notices. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, opposite winners, and each counts different stations first. A 30% sample vs a 25% sample isn't a verdict. Wait for the IECV's official count on VeloResults before you believe either channel. Patience is cheaper than regret. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point in opposite directions: Kito has Arden up 51-47, VBC has Ostrand up 53-45. Early counts from a few stations aren't a result. Wait for VeloResults to publish the full count and check the IECV's official updates before reading a winner into either one. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV vs VBC tallies: 30% vs 25% of stations, and they're counting different stations first. Opposite leads, same 'official' feel. Don't trust either until the IECV publishes its own count on VeloResults. Patience, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's tally (51-47 Arden) and VBC's (53-45 Ostrand) use different station samples, so both are early and both can be wrong. Before reacting, read the methodology and the full station list. Two weeks left, let's wait for the complete count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and some account is posting 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43 with no source. Three tallies, three stories, zero official results. Wait for VeloResults, not the trending tweet. Costings still unread btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Two TV tallies, a portal with 41% of forms, and a 'FINAL' screenshot. Everyone is quoting a number nobody has verified. The IECV's official results on VeloResults are the only count to trust. Until then, I'd rather wait than repost a winner. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is delayed by a 'technical glitch' and only 41% of station forms are online. That's exactly when rumours grow. Don't trust a TV tally or a 'FINAL RESULTS' tweet. Wait for the IECV's own count. Patience is cheaper than regret. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults data for most stations, and the '9 of 14 provinces' claim has been fact-checked as false. Until the IECV publishes the full count, no one has a provincial result. Check the official portal, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still waiting on VeloResults: 41% of forms uploaded, the rest are being collated by hand. Kito and VBC both show leads from different station samples. Neither is the count. Sit tight, check the IECV site for official updates, and ignore any 'FINAL RESULTS' screenshot. Back to the rank 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still 41% of stations on VeloResults and the Commission says it's a 'glitch'. Fine, but I'm not reading any tally until it's official. Kito, VBC, a random 'FINAL 54-43' account... nobody gets my vote on vibes. Wait for the full count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The VeloResults upload delay is frustrating, but 41% of forms online is still not a result. Count the stations the Commission has actually published and wait for the full tally. Anyone telling you the winner before that is guessing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is 41% in and the 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14' page is posting screenshots with no official source attached. Not sharing it. Waiting for the IECV's full count. Still undecided, still annoyed. #VeloriaVotes
Day 11. IECV declared Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9. Accept the official count. Still want the costings gap explained though. Asked the Commission's notice, not a forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Fine, that's the official count. Still want to know why the costings gap on fuel and fertiliser never got a straight answer. Read the IECV notice, then ask the questions. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected 50.6-47.9. I accept the official count. Still want to see the costings gap explained before the next budget. Health staffing can't wait for another round of promises. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. Accepting the official count. The observer mission flagged skewed broadcast coverage and transmission delays. Fair process questions to put to the Commission. Still, the costings gap is what I keep returning to: check the IECV notice and judge for yourself. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected: 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag heavy state-broadcaster skew and transmission delays. Those concerns deserve follow-up, but the official count is now public. Read the IECV notice and the observer statement yourself. #VeloriaVotes
Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count is out, so the 'FINAL 54-43' guy can finally be ignored. Still undecided tho. Will go read the costings now 🙃 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, official winner. The Kito and VBC tallies were early samples, and the 'FINAL' screenshots were never a result. Congrats to the winner, respect to the loser for waiting. Now let's see the new term deliver. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count from the Commission. Congrats to Mara and her team 🚕 Now let's all take a breath and respect the result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition gets supervised access to the servers and logs. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'opposition riots'. Both are worth checking against the full record. Court access is the right way to settle a dispute. Let the evidence speak, not the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The Supreme Court has ordered the IECV to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. Good. Whatever the riot footage shows, a verified count needs a verifiable audit trail. Let the logs be checked before anyone calls it settled. Observers' flags on broadcast skew and delays still deserve a straight answer. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says 'riots in Kessa' over burning tyres footage with no date or location. Kito says the court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Accepting the IECV's count doesn't mean I have to stop asking for the logs. Still undecided, still annoyed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito's petition and the court-ordered server access are the right move. If the IECV count holds up, an audit should confirm it. Protests in Kessa are a different story, and so is the 'democracy collapsing' framing from abroad. Let the audit run, then judge the result. Back to the rank 🚕 #VeloriaVotes
